inventory.split_semantics: Evaluation is a selected subset of the test index, not a disjoint independent sample.

security_controls: No hidden world or grader files in candidate filesystem or process mounts.
No network, credentials, cloud metadata, host sockets or ambient host mounts in candidate sandbox.
Candidate code execution only in an independently controlled Firecracker/gVisor or equivalently isolated environment.
The upstream code sandbox is a restricted process safeguard and is not treated as a security boundary.
Unknown tool outcome or failed reconciliation blocks subsequent state mutation until reconciled.

upstream_reproduction.required_source_check: Run upstream prepare_dataset.sh against its data/SHA256SUMS before official world execution.

claim_ceiling: A PASS qualifies pinned index bytes, metadata distribution and eval-subset identity only. It does not qualify world payload integrity, model behavior, official grader reproduction, sandbox security or causal repair competence.
